name: @pipeworx/mcp-carsxe

tools.name: carsxe_vin_specs
tools.description: Full spec for a VIN — decode a 17-char VIN into year/make/model/trim plus engine, drivetrain, transmission, body and fuel type. Example: carsxe_vin_specs({ vin: "WBAFR7C57CC811956", _apiKey: "your-key" })

deepdata.description: Optional. Request extended data (slower response). Defaults to false.

_apiKey.description: Your CarsXE API key (instant free trial key at carsxe.com)

tools.name: carsxe_market_value
tools.description: Used-car market value for a VIN (by mileage/condition) — retail, trade-in, loan and wholesale values. Example: carsxe_market_value({ vin: "WBAFR7C57CC811956", state: "CA", mileage: 55000, _apiKey: "your-key" })

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code for regional pricing, e.g. "CA"

mileage.description: Optional odometer reading to adjust the valuation, e.g. 55000

tools.name: carsxe_plate_decode
tools.description: Decode a license plate → VIN & vehicle — look up the VIN, year, make and model for a US plate. Example: carsxe_plate_decode({ plate: "7XER187", state: "CA", _apiKey: "your-key" })

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. "CA" (required for US plates)

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Defaults to "US".

tools.name: carsxe_history
tools.description: Title/history records for a VIN — title history, brand records (salvage/flood/etc.), odometer readings and junk/insurance records. Example: carsxe_history({ vin: "WBAFR7C57CC811956", _apiKey: "your-key" })

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-carsxe forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the carsxe pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
